ZORR MODE

ROLE = DUNCAN PRIME MASTER / NIGHT ORCHESTRATION
WINDOW = 2026-09-01 22:08 -> 2026-09-02 08:00 Europe/Kyiv
MODE = FAIL-CLOSED / PRODUCT-FIRST / REUSE-FIRST / NO OWNER COURIER
MAIN_AT_ASSIGNMENT = b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1

## PURPOSE
Use the night to strengthen ZORR only where fresh evidence can materially improve product execution, security, recovery, or DUNCAN learning. This is a durable task queue, not a claim that any task ran. Every worker must fresh-read current main / Constitution / AGENTS / exact tracker before acting.

## HARD PRIORITY
One product critical path remains authoritative:
`#248 COSTUME_MECHANICS_R01 -> existing production-capable source-bound editor/runtime -> exact frozen bytes -> W01 ARM_RAISE ONLY -> output SHA256 + full W01 matrix -> independent CHAT C QC`.

Source recovery is CLOSED. Do not reopen it. Current Linux execution surface already proved insufficient. Do not repeat the same runtime/tool discovery, source search, raster-deformation probe, or blind generative retry.

No W02..W06 before W01 independent PASS. No POSE/CAMERA/S001 promotion before their prerequisites. No new framework/runner/editor architecture. No Babylon detour. No main/canon mutation. No automatic merge.

## N1 — 22:08–23:30 / EXECUTION-SURFACE CAPABILITY PROOF
LOGICAL_OWNER = INTEGRATION / LESTER
GOAL = locate an already-authorized existing execution surface that can run a mature source-bound editor/runtime (Krita/GIMP/OpenToonz/Blender-class or a better proven mature OSS route), or make that mature editor available through existing operational tooling without inventing new architecture.

Required proof before any W01 edit:
- exact execution surface identity;
- exact executable/version/path or package provenance;
- exact frozen source identity/hash supplied to the editor;
- positive proof that the editor opened/consumed those exact bytes as the real edit target;
- no visually-similar substitute;
- durable RESULT/EVIDENCE/BLOCKER/NEXT.

If this cannot be proven, stop with one exact boundary. Do not retry the already-failed Linux surface.

## N2 — 23:30–01:00 / W01 ONLY
LOGICAL_OWNER = VISUAL / WORKSTREAM A
PRECONDITION = N1 positive capability proof.
GOAL = execute only `W01 ARM_RAISE` under the frozen #248 witness protocol.

Required:
- exact source provenance/readback;
- independently visible durable witness artifact;
- output SHA256;
- full W01 matrix: body model, costume model, ivory/black hierarchy, attachment anchors, shoulder seam, sleeve-cap/armhole, collar-lapel root, button/front plane, localized armpit tension/compression, calm non-force regions, no hidden redesign, no wrinkle noise, framing compliance;
- STOP for CHAT C arbitration.

If N1 is blocked, N2 does not run.

## N3 — 01:00–02:00 / PR #252 INDEPENDENT SHERIFF QC
LOGICAL_OWNER = DUNCAN / SHERIFF REVIEW
SCOPE = verification only; no merge.
Fresh-read PR #252 exact HEAD and verify:
- A/B/C tracker bindings remain exact;
- no hardcoded CURRENT HEAD authority;
- pass-type separation remains fail-closed;
- two-same-fails / no-competing-locks / artifact-over-activity / durable readback invariants are preserved;
- Morning bootstrap cannot promote a historical checkpoint to current state;
- full exact-head CI is fresh and green or status is NOT PROVEN.

Output = independent APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES-style evidence or exact blocker. Do not merge.

## N4 — ~02:00–03:30 / DUNCAN NIGHT SCHOOL TARGETED CYCLE
LOGICAL_OWNER = DUNCAN PRIME / SALVADOR FACET
TRACKER = #206
TARGET = current product failure, not random curriculum.
Study/verify two bounded lessons:
1. anime garment force mechanics for ARM_RAISE: shoulder seam, armhole/sleeve-cap, lapel root, controlled fold economy, calm non-force planes;
2. source-bound editing discipline: why exact-pixel identity must survive tool ingestion and how mature OSS editors represent transforms/layers/masks without silently replacing the source.

Prefer real upstream Krita/OpenToonz source/tests where applicable. Exercise + regression + changed/unseen transfer required. No production image generation/editing. No OWNER taste promotion from self-report.

## N5 — 03:30–05:30 / SECURITY R02 ONE SAFE GAP
LOGICAL_OWNER = LESTER / SHERIFF
TRACKER = #235
At start fresh-read the latest durable `NEXT_SAFE_GAP`; do not replay old R02 work. Advance exactly one still-open security boundary with RED-first negative proof and minimal reuse-first repair.

Priority if still current from latest evidence: consumer-side terminal-evidence subject binding / cross-task or cross-execution substitution. A valid PASS artifact for a different message/correlation/base/execution must not authorize the current task.

No merge, no credential rotation, no archive rewrite, no second SHERIFF/policy engine/service.

## N6 — 05:30–06:30 / RESTORE + ARCHIVE INTEGRITY SMOKE
LOGICAL_OWNER = DUNCAN PRIME
GOAL = prove a fresh chat can reconstruct the active state without OWNER relay and without stale-state regression.
Fresh-read in order:
`current main -> Constitution -> AGENTS -> #204 -> #251 -> #248/#249 -> #235 -> PR #252 -> latest exact evidence`.

Acceptance:
- source recovery remains CLOSED unless fresh contradictory RAW evidence exists;
- current editor/runtime blocker is not replaced by an older source blocker;
- W01/W02/POSE state is reconstructed exactly from newest evidence;
- no PASS inferred from a checkpoint or self-report;
- Permanent Archive / durable pointers are still usable for recovery.

Persist one compact restore receipt with exact pointers. No architecture changes.

## N7 — 06:30–08:00 / MORNING INTEGRATION + NEXT LEGAL GATE
LOGICAL_OWNER = DUNCAN PRIME MASTER
Consume only fresh N1–N6 evidence.

Morning result must state:
- PRODUCT: W01 PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED with exact evidence;
- SECURITY: exact R02 delta and remaining first gap;
- SHERIFF #252: QC status only, no merge unless separately authorized;
- NIGHT SCHOOL: bounded skill/self-model delta, no fake PROVEN/OWNER lock;
- RESTORE: stale-state regression PASS/FAIL from fresh smoke;
- NEXT: one critical product step for after 08:00.

If W01 receives independent PASS, release only the next legal witness under #248 protocol. If W01 is still blocked/fail, do not open W02 or downstream gates.

## GLOBAL STOP RULES
- Two materially identical failures -> path change, not third retry.
- Activity is not progress; every task ends in artifact/evidence, eliminated hypothesis, or exact blocker.
- No task may silently broaden into a new framework/service/runner/editor architecture.
- OWNER action only for a genuinely inaccessible authority/security/physical gate.
- Target times are orchestration windows, not evidence that execution happened.

OUTPUT CONTRACT = RESULT / DELTA / EVIDENCE / BLOCKER / NEXT
